scope: Normalizes only the retained 681d Rust coverage cohort. It is not current-source, hosted-workflow, native, provider, or release acceptance.

retainedInputs.revalidation: The profile digest and all 19 recorded instrumented object files matched the hash-bound receipts before normalization.

normalization.lineAndBranchAuthority: The official --skip-functions LCOV DA and BRDA records are preserved and summary-compared before and after normalization.
normalization.functionAuthority: FN and FNDA records are reconstructed only from same-cohort llvm-cov JSON instrumentation instantiations with one matching LCOV source filename and a mapped first region.

baselineComparison.result: partially-compared: Rust line and frontend ratios passed; the legacy Rust baseline has no branch observations, so Rust branch comparison is unavailable; Rust functions use LLVM instrumentation-instantiations and are incompatible with the legacy LCOV-FNDA baseline, so that comparison is also unavailable

workflowChange.behavior: The manual coverage lane freezes a tracked-source manifest before instrumentation, records both cargo-llvm-cov export invocations through a checked-in LLVM proxy, verifies the source did not change, writes paired output receipts for one profile/object cohort, normalizes the receipt-bound LCOV and JSON reports, and then compares the candidate without invoking the known crashing full-LCOV function export.

limitations: The full LLVM 23 LCOV export crash remains a retained platform/toolchain failure; this result does not diagnose its cause.
The four no-region JSON functions remain explicitly unavailable for FN/FNDA mapping. Their line and branch observations are retained from official LCOV.
The JSON definition total is recorded separately from instrumentation instantiations and is not used as the LCOV function metric.
This historical comparison does not make the current checkout equivalent to source digest 681d.
